decisions.statement: A color here is a color the design tokens have.
Every color a turn state names is a name here.
The color a stopped seat names answers with the text color.
A color is answered as a hex triplet.
A name is lowercased before being matched.
A name matching no color is answered as nothing rather than as a fallback.
A channel outside the range is pulled to the nearest end before being written.
The names are answered as a set of their own.
The names are answered in an order, and that is the order they are shown in.
The loudest turn state's color leads that order.
Nothing here says which terminal or row takes which color.
Nothing here reads a color the editor's own theme names.

definition: the color names the editor admits and the hex triplet each name answers with
